name: Saturday show at the tower
nameVi: Đêm thứ Bảy sân Tháp Nhạn
summary: Every Saturday at 19:30 the English tourism page puts a show in the Tháp Nhạn yard, named “Phu Yen – the attractive and friendly destination.” It does not print that show on other nights. The length was not printed. Check on arrival. No fee was printed. The photograph is the tower lit after dark, not the show.
when: Every Saturday at 19:30. Length: check on arrival.
